pages.title: Central Malawi
pages.extract: Central Malawi lies on the southern part of the eastern shores of Lake Malawi and is home to the capital of Lilongwe.  Its fairly flat terrain disguises the fact that it is part of the high plateau of central Africa.

pages.title: Cincinnati
pages.description: city in and seat of Hamilton County, Ohio, United States
pages.extract:
Cincinnati is Ohio's third largest city and the largest metro region, and lies on the north bank of the Ohio River in Southwest Ohio in the United States of America.
Cincinnati is distinct amongst Midwestern cities.  Its culture is a mixture of the Northeast, Old South, Midwest,  and Appalachia blended with a strong German-Catholic heritage. It was one of the United States' early boomtowns, and the Over-the-Rhine neighborhood is the largest National Historic District in the country. Today, it's part of a fast-growing metro area, and home to a remarkable blend of industry and architecture. Downtown Cincinnati is surrounded by picturesque foothills that add a beautiful backdrop to the Queen City and its legendary skyline – celebrated in the opening credits of television show WKRP in Cincinnati.

pages.title: Iga
pages.extract: Iga (伊賀), also known as Iga-Ueno (伊賀上野), is a city in Mie prefecture, Japan.

pages.extract: Majete Wildlife Reserve is in the Chikwawa District of Malawi.

pages.title: Saskatoon
pages.extract: Saskatoon is a city in West Central Saskatchewan. With a metropolitan population of approximately 317,000 people (2021), it is the province's largest city, and its economic and cultural hub. It has a beautiful setting along the South Saskatchewan River, and makes the most of it with parks and bridges. It's a little oasis among wheat fields.

pages.title: Springfield (Ohio)
pages.description: county seat of Clark County, Ohio, United States
pages.extract: Springfield is a city in Clark County, Ohio.

pages.title: Tattenhall
pages.extract: Tattenhall is a village in Cheshire. It is near to Beeston Castle, a ruined 13th-century castle, and sits along the Sandstone Trail, a long-distance walkers' path, between Frodsham to Whitchurch.

pages.title: Itabuna
pages.extract: Itabuna is a town inland from the Cocoa Coast in Southern Bahia.

pages.title: Clarens
pages.description: town in the eastern Free State, South Africa
pages.extract: Clarens is a village (2011 population about 6,500) in the Free State. It attracts more visitors than most other villages for two reasons. Many artists live in or visit the region and the village has several galleries. Also, it is a convenient base for visiting Golden Gate Highlands Park.

pages.title: Spessart
pages.extract: Spessart is in Lower Franconia of Germany.

pages.title: Vélez-Málaga
pages.extract: Vélez-Málaga is a town in the province of Málaga, Spain. It is the capital of the Axarquía comarca and an important market town and supply centre for the region. Perched on a hill 4 km inland from Torre del Mar — a seaside resort on the Costa del Sol — its Moorish old town is a low-profile touristic destination.

pages.title: Forfar
pages.extract: Forfar is the county town of Angus, 13 miles north of Dundee, with a population in 2022 of 15,700. Its main attractions are Glamis Castle, and the fine Pictish stones here and at Meigle and Aberlemno.

pages.title: Hernandarias
pages.description: district and city in Alto Paraná, Paraguay
pages.extract: Hernandarias is a district and city of the Alto Paraná Department. It is 349 km from Asunción, and is known as the "Latin American Capital of Electric Power". It had a population of about 80,000 in 2008.

pages.title: Pateley Bridge
pages.description: town in Nidderdale in the borough of Harrogate, North Yorkshire, England
pages.extract: Pateley Bridge is a town in North Yorkshire. Here the River Nidd emerges from the karstic valleys of the Yorkshire Dales into the broad plain of the Vale of York, so the town is a good base for exploring both areas. In 2024 the population was 1300.
